end.summary:
- Practised how earthworm tunnels let air and water into soil.
- Practised how soil animals help turn dead leaves into rich soil.
- Earthworm-as-pest idea was corrected by turn 10.
- Named ants, millipedes and beetles; spider was correctly separated from insects.
- Full soil-animal naming list was not completed; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the lesson through questions, examples and a teach-back. Pihu explained by the end that earthworm tunnels let water reach roots and that earthworms help rather than harm soil. They mixed up some soil animals and insects at first; the earthworm idea was corrected later, while the complete naming list still needs practice. At home, use a picture chart to name and sort earthworm, ant, beetle, millipede, woodlouse and termite, noting that a spider is not an insect.
